rules.description: Ctrl+Alt+key is Command+Option+key outside terminals, as Google Docs, Sheets and Slides use it (PC muscle memory, alongside the setup-macos modifier rotation)
Ctrl+Backspace and Ctrl+Delete delete a word, and Ctrl+Y redoes, outside terminals (PC muscle memory, alongside the setup-macos modifier rotation)
Ctrl+J opens Downloads and Ctrl+H History in Chrome and Brave (PC muscle memory, alongside the setup-macos modifier rotation)
F2 renames in Finder (PC muscle memory, alongside the setup-macos modifier rotation)
